title: SecretType
description: Secret kind; drives validation, normalization, and safe downstream use.
x-enumDescriptions: Generic login or device/API password (e.g., CLI exec).
Privileged/enable password used after exec/login on network devices.
Passphrase protecting the SSH private key (if any).
Opaque bearer token (e.g., OAuth2 access token).
TLS client certificate in PEM (-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----).
TLS client private key in PEM (-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----).
CA bundle in PEM (one or more CA certs).
Arbitrary secret blob (discouraged unless no specific type fits).
